metadata.story-title: Fix C++ Compilation Errors and Enable Toubkal Browser

story.i-want: the Toubkal C++ code to compile successfully and integrate with the Chromium build system
story.so-that: I can build and run the actual Toubkal browser with working `toubkal://` URL schemes instead of just standard Chrome

acceptance-criteria.criterion: All Toubkal C++ components compile without errors
Toubkal browser builds successfully using GN + Ninja
`toubkal://` URL scheme is registered and functional
Toubkal browser launches with proper branding
`toubkal://settings` and other internal pages work correctly
Privacy components integrate with the browser engine
Build system includes all Toubkal components in the build

doc.title: Toubkal Browser Product Roadmap
doc.snippet: Phase 1 establishes cryptographically verifiable privacy, zero-telemetry baseline, and Toubkal brand identity. Core deliverables include GN + Siso build system, brand identity implementation, consent fabric, and transparency dashboard.

doc.title: Privacy & Ethics Policy
doc.snippet: Toubkal's privacy model is mathematically verifiable. Every data flow is cryptographically signed (Ed25519), every AI operation requires explicit consent, and every claim is auditable by independent third parties.

doc.title: Toubkal Browser Coding Rules
doc.snippet: Critical C++ rules include: NO bare string throws (use Error objects), NO unhandled promises (always await or .catch()), NO 'any' type (use unknown + type guards), NO silent error swallowing (always log errors with context), NO non-null assertions (use proper null checking).

file.reason: Main build configuration for Toubkal browser components, includes URL scheme registration and branding dependencies
file.snippet: source_set("toubkal_browser") with deps on content/public/browser, url, base, url_scheme_registration, and toubkal/browser/branding. Includes C++17 support.

file.reason: Core URL scheme registration function that needs to be called during browser initialization
file.snippet: Registers toubkal:// as a standard, secure, local, and web-displayable scheme using url::AddStandardScheme("toubkal", url::SCHEME_WITH_HOST).

file.reason: Header file declaring URL scheme registration functions
file.snippet: Declares RegisterToubkalUrlScheme(), GetToubkalRedirectUrl(), IsValidToubkalInternalUrl(), and GetSupportedToubkalInternalPages() functions.

file.reason: Main browser client that needs to integrate URL scheme registration
file.snippet: Content browser client that should call RegisterToubkalUrlScheme() during initialization to register the toubkal:// scheme.

file.reason: Branding build configuration that needs to be uncommented and integrated
file.snippet: Build configuration for Toubkal branding components including window title manager, branding config, and branding integration.
Build configuration for privacy components including fingerprinting protection, tracker blocker, and Brave shields manager.

package.name: base
package.reason: Required for logging and basic utilities

interface.reason: Core function to register toubkal:// URL scheme with Chromium

interface.name: GetToubkalRedirectUrl
interface.reason: Function to redirect chrome:// URLs to toubkal:// URLs

interface.name: IsValidToubkalInternalUrl
interface.reason: Function to validate toubkal:// internal URLs

interface.name: ToubkalContentBrowserClient
interface.reason: Main browser client class that needs to integrate URL scheme registration

constraints.constraint: All C++ code must compile without errors or warnings
Must integrate with Chromium GN + Ninja build system
toubkal:// URL scheme must be registered as standard, secure, local, and web-displayable
Toubkal branding must replace Chrome branding in built browser
Privacy components must integrate with browser's network stack
Must maintain Chromium compatibility and follow Chromium patterns
All functionality must be testable and verified

tests.standards: All C++ code must compile without warnings, full browser build must complete successfully, toubkal:// URLs must work (not fall back to search), internal pages must load correctly, privacy components must be functional. Testing should include unit tests for individual components, integration tests for URL scheme registration, and end-to-end tests for complete browser functionality.

test.description: Test that all Toubkal C++ components compile individually and as part of the full build
Test that gn gen and autoninja commands complete successfully with Toubkal components
Test that toubkal:// URLs are registered and don't fall back to Google search
Test that Toubkal branding appears in browser window title and about page
Test that toubkal://settings, toubkal://about, and other internal pages load correctly
Test that privacy components are functional in the actual browser context
Test that all Toubkal components are included in the build output

current-problem.issue: Standard Chromium builds successfully (55,119 files compiled) but Toubkal C++ code has compilation errors
Missing includes (base/strings/string_piece.h), deprecated APIs (NonNetworkURLLoaderFactoryInfo), namespace issues (std::vector, url::AddStandardScheme)
toubkal:// URLs don't work - they fall back to Google search because scheme isn't registered
No actual Toubkal browser - just standard Chrome with different name

implementation-notes.note: Fix all C++ compilation errors in Toubkal components before attempting build integration
URL scheme registration must be called during browser initialization in ToubkalContentBrowserClient
Build system integration requires updating src/toubkal/browser/BUILD.gn to include all components
Branding integration requires uncommenting and fixing //toubkal/browser/branding target
Privacy components must be connected to browser's network service for proper integration
All internal pages (settings, about, audit, consent, etc.) must be implemented and functional
